name: riskbricks-supervisor-agent
system_prompt: You are the supervisor agent. Use tools to gather retrieval, forecast, risk, factor, decision, and evaluation context and synthesize a final recommendation.

tools.name: get_news_context
tools.description: Return recent news context for a symbol.

tools.name: get_news_impact_stats
tools.description: Return historical news impact statistics for a symbol.

tools.name: get_latest_forecast
tools.description: Return the latest forecast for a symbol and target date.

tools.name: get_risk_metrics
tools.description: Return risk metrics for a symbol.

tools.name: get_factor_exposures
tools.description: Return latest factor exposures for a symbol.

tools.name: get_decision_signal
tools.description: Return the latest decision signal for a symbol.

tools.name: get_forecast_eval
tools.description: Return evaluation metrics for a symbol and target date.
